game_concept: A racing platformer set in Eldritch Ruins – Moonstone Terrace, a terrace of moonstone: the relic hunter must handle echo phantoms while practicing lists. Core idea – Search Scout: Use in and index() to find where a hidden item sits in a list.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Moonstone Terrace: a terrace of moonstone
core_gameplay_loop: In Moonstone Terrace, repeat each round: Use in and index() to find where a hidden item sits in a list. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the relic hunter ahead. Then check the found value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the heart stone by solving code steps involving found that move the relic hunter forward.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.9).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the heart stone first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 9 (extended tier): Search Scout
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Search Scout' (Week 7 slot 7), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Moonstone Terrace'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Eldritch Ruins
region.mood: eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how found changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against echo phantoms in Moonstone Terrace.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.9).
